title: Segment Lens
intro: Every number and preview on this page comes from the Segment Atlas dataset, and every mesh it measures is a tifxyz folder on the open-data bucket. Both read straight from these URLs, with no account.

sources.title: Segment Atlas (one row per published mesh)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data)
sources.note: Each row has the mesh's open-data url, its grid size, area, filled share, edge statistics and the holes, folds and stretched area that kit tifxyz check reports. lens/ holds the decimated 3D previews.

sources.title: A measured mesh (tifxyz), example PHerc0009B 20250510172639
sources.note: Every row of the atlas names its mesh folder in url; the table's mesh folder link opens it. Read live from the open-data bucket, never copied here.
